tr: Başkalarının rüyalarına girip sırlarını çalan bir hırsız, bu kez tersini yapıp bir iş adamının zihnine fikir yerleştirmekle görevlendirilir ve rüyanın içindeki rüya katmanlarında ilerler.

out.en_query: A thief who enters people's dreams to steal secrets is tasked with planting an idea into a businessman's mind through nested dream layers.
out.hyde: A skilled thief specializes in corporate espionage by entering the subconscious of his targets while they sleep to extract valuable secrets. He is offered a chance to regain his old life in exchange for performing inception, the act of planting an original idea into a target's mind. To achieve this, he assembles a specialized team to navigate multiple layers of dreams within dreams inside an heir to a business empire. As they venture deeper into the subconscious realm, unstable dream environments and tragic projections from the thief's past threaten the success of the mission.

tr: Güçlü bir mafya babası suikast girişiminde ağır yaralanınca, aile işinden uzak duran en küçük oğul intikam alıp suç örgütünün yeni lideri olur.

out.en_query: A powerful mafia boss is severely wounded in an assassination attempt, prompting his reluctant youngest son to take revenge and become the new crime boss.
out.hyde: Vito Corleone, the patriarch of an Italian-American mafia family, is critically wounded during an assassination attempt orchestrated by a rival mob family. As Vito lies incapacitated in the hospital, his youngest son, Michael, who had previously distanced himself from the family business, steps in to protect his father. Driven by loyalty and revenge, Michael assassinates the rival mob leader and a corrupt police captain responsible for the hit. After fleeing to Sicily to lay low, Michael returns to New York to officially assume control of the family business as the new Don.

tr: Farklı sınıflardan zengin bir genç kadınla yoksul bir ressam, devasa bir yolcu gemisinin ilk seferinde aşık olur; gemi buzdağına çarpıp batarken hayatta kalmaya çalışırlar.

out.en_query: A wealthy young woman and a poor painter fall in love on the maiden voyage of a massive passenger ship that hits an iceberg
out.hyde: On the maiden voyage of the RMS Titanic in 1912, a seventeen-year-old aristocratic girl named Rose falls in love with Jack Dawson, a penniless artist who won his third-class ticket in a poker game. Despite the interference of Rose's snobbish fiancé and controlling mother, the two form a deep bond across social classes. Their passionate romance is threatened when the luxurious ocean liner collides with a massive iceberg in the North Atlantic Ocean. As the ship swiftly fills with water and begins to founder, Jack and Rose must struggle against time, freezing ocean waters, and violent chaos to survive.

tr: Yoksul bir ailenin bütün fertleri, sahte kimliklerle zengin bir ailenin evinde tek tek iş bulur; ta ki evin gizli bir sırrı ortaya çıkana kadar.

out.en_query: A poor family infiltrates a wealthy household using fake identities until a hidden secret in the house is revealed.
out.hyde: A destitute family living in a cramped subterranean apartment schemes to secure employment in the lavish home of a wealthy elite family. By posing as unrelated skilled professionals, each family member systematically replaces the existing staff, taking over roles as tutors, a driver, and a housekeeper. They thrive on the newly acquired wealth and comfort, effortlessly maintaining their elaborate charade. Their delicate operation unravels during a stormy night when the former housekeeper returns, leading to the discovery of a secret basement bunker concealed beneath the mansion.

tr: Karısını ve sevgilisini öldürmekten haksız yere mahkûm olan bir bankacı hapishanede yıllarca dayanır, bir mahkûmla dostluk kurar ve sonunda ustaca bir kaçış planlar.

out.en_query: A banker unjustly convicted of murdering his wife and her lover endures years in prison, forms a friendship with a fellow inmate, and plans a clever escape.
out.hyde: A successful banker is wrongly convicted of murdering his wife and her lover, receiving two life sentences in a harsh state prison. Over several decades, he endures brutal conditions while forming a deep bond with a fellow inmate known for smuggling contraband. Using his expertise in finance, he earns the trust of the prison guards and the corrupt warden by managing their financial affairs. Behind a poster in his cell, he secretly spends years digging a tunnel through the wall with a small rock hammer. Ultimately, he executes a brilliant escape during a stormy night and seeks freedom abroad.

tr: Doğduğu günden beri farkında olmadan bir televizyon programının kahramanı olan adam, hayatının sahte bir dekordan ibaret olduğunu fark edip kaçmaya çalışır.

out.en_query: A man unknowingly raised on a reality television show set realizes his life is fake and tries to escape.
out.hyde: Since his birth, Truman has lived in an idyllic seaside town, completely unaware that his life is the subject of a 24-hour global reality television broadcast. Everyone around him, including his wife and closest friends, are paid actors working within a colossal domed studio set. After a series of technical glitches and strange occurrences, Truman begins to question the nature of his reality. He uncovers the truth about the artificial environment and decides to conquer his deep-seated fear of water to escape. Navigating a sailboat to the edge of the dome, he finds a door leading out into the real world.

tr: Küçük bir kasabaya şenlik haberi yapmaya giden alaycı bir hava durumu sunucusu aynı günü tekrar tekrar yaşar ve sonunda daha iyi bir insan olmayı öğrenir.

out.en_query: A cynical weather presenter trapped in a time loop in a small town during a festival learns to become a better person
out.hyde: An arrogant TV weather reporter travels to a small town to cover its annual winter festival, viewing the assignment with bitter contempt. After completing the broadcast, a sudden blizzard prevents him from leaving the town, forcing him to stay overnight. The next morning, he wakes up to discover that he is reliving the exact same day with all its events repeating endlessly. Initially using the situation for selfish pleasure, he eventually sinks into despair before deciding to improve himself by mastering various skills and helping the townsfolk. Through endless daily repetitions, he learns empathy, opens his heart to love, and finally breaks the loop as a changed man.

tr: Uzak bir gezegenden gelen bir sinyali araştıran ticari uzay gemisinin mürettebatı, gemiye sızan ölümcül bir yaratık tarafından tek tek avlanır.

out.en_query: The crew of a commercial spaceship investigating a signal from a distant planet is hunted down one by one by a deadly creature on board.
out.hyde: The crew of the commercial cargo ship Nostos is awakened from hyper-sleep to investigate a mysterious distress beacon originating from a desolate moon. While exploring a ruined alien vessel on the surface, a crew member is attacked by an unknown organism that attaches itself to his face. After bringing the injured crew member back aboard, a lethal parasitic alien bursts from his chest and escapes into the ship's air ducts. As the rapidly growing monster stalks the dark corridors, it picks off the crew members one by one. The surviving officer attempts to trigger the ship's self-destruct sequence and escape in an auxiliary pod before the creature can reach Earth.

tr: Kargo uçağı okyanusa düşen, zamana takıntılı bir kurye ıssız bir adada yıllarca hayatta kalmaya çalışır ve sonunda eve dönmeyi başarır.

out.en_query: A time-obsessed courier whose cargo plane crashes into the ocean survives for years on a deserted island before finding a way back home.
out.hyde: A time-obsessed logistics inspector is stranded on an uninhabited island in the South Pacific after his cargo plane crashes during a severe storm. With no human contact, he learns basic survival skills, utilizing the contents of salvaged courier packages to build shelter and gather food. To cope with severe loneliness, he paints a face on a volleyball and talks to it as a companion. After spending four solitary years on the island, he constructs a wooden raft with a makeshift sail to navigate past the dangerous crashing waves. He is eventually picked up by a cargo vessel and returns to civilization to rebuild his life.

tr: Bacağı alçıda evde oturmak zorunda kalan bir fotoğrafçı, pencereden karşı apartmanı gözetler ve komşusunun karısını öldürdüğünden şüphelenir.

out.en_query: A photographer confined to his apartment with a broken leg spies on his neighbors and suspects a murder.
out.hyde: A professional photographer is confined to a wheelchair in his apartment while recovering from a broken leg. With little else to do, he spends his time observing his neighbors through his rear window using binoculars and a camera lens. He becomes fixated on a salesman living across the courtyard whose bedridden wife suddenly vanishes under mysterious circumstances. Suspecting that the salesman has murdered his wife, the photographer enlists his girlfriend and personal nurse to help investigate the situation.

tr: Ailesi domuza dönüşen küçük bir kız, ruhların uğrak yeri olan bir hamamda çalışmak zorunda kalır ve ailesini kurtarmak için mücadele eder.

out.en_query: A young girl whose parents are turned into pigs must work in a bathhouse for spirits to save her family.
out.hyde: While moving to a new neighborhood, ten-year-old Chihiro and her parents stumble upon an abandoned theme park that is secretly a realm for supernatural spirits. After her parents greedily eat food from an unattended stall, they are transformed into pigs. Stranded in the spirit world, Chihiro meets a mysterious boy named Haku who helps her obtain employment at a bathhouse catering to various spirits and deities. Ruled by the tyrannical witch Yubaba, Chihiro must work hard, retain her identity, and brave numerous magical challenges to break the curse on her parents and return to the human world.

tr: Bir bale topluluğundaki mükemmeliyetçi dansçı, hem masum hem baştan çıkarıcı iki rolü birden oynama baskısı altında gerçeklikle bağını yitirmeye başlar.

out.en_query: A perfectionist dancer in a ballet company loses her grip on reality under the pressure of playing dual innocent and seductive roles.
out.hyde: Nina is a dedicated ballerina in a prestigious New York City ballet company whose life is entirely consumed by dance. When the artistic director decides to replace the lead dancer for their season-opening production of Swan Lake, Nina is selected for the lead role. However, the production requires a dancer who can portray both the innocent White Swan and the sensual, dark Black Swan. As a rival dancer emerges who effortlessly embodies the Black Swan's allure, Nina descends into a nightmare of intense psychological pressure. Consumed by obsession and paranoia, she begins to suffer from terrifying hallucinations, gradually losing her hold on reality.

tr: Haydutların talanına uğrayan yoksul bir köyün çiftçileri, köylerini savunmak için yedi başıboş savaşçıyı tutar.

out.en_query: Poor village farmers hire seven masterless warriors to defend against raiding bandits
out.hyde: A small, impoverished farming village is repeatedly raided by a ruthless gang of bandits who steal their crops. Desperate for protection, the villagers send emissaries to the city to hire masterless warriors willing to fight for food. A veteran warrior agrees to help and recruits six other skilled fighters with varied backgrounds. Together, they travel to the village, fortify its defenses, and train the timid farmers in basic combat. When the bandits launch their assault, a fierce battle ensues, resulting in heavy casualties but ultimately securing the village's freedom.

tr: Yaşlandıkça şirketinin satışları düşen bir kozmetik patroniçesi, sahtekâr sayılıp kovulmuş bir bilim insanının arı salgılarından yaptığı gençleştirici kürü kullanır ve bunun korkunç yan etkileri ortaya çıkar.

out.en_query: A cosmetics mogul uses an experimental rejuvenating serum made from queen bee secretions by a disgraced scientist, suffering horrific side effects.
out.hyde: Janice Starlin, the founder of a successful cosmetics firm, notices sales declining as she ages and loses her youthful looks. In desperation, she contacts Dr. Zinthrop, a disgraced scientist who claims to have developed a youth-restoring enzyme extracted from queen bees. After receiving secret injections of the formula, Janice miraculously regains her youth and beauty, boosting her company's success. However, the serum soon produces horrific side effects, causing her to periodically transform into a violent, bloodthirsty creature. As her colleagues grow suspicious of her strange behavior and missing staff members, Janice struggles to control her monstrous impulses.

tr: Zengin ailesinden harçlık alan şımarık bir genç, gentrifikasyon yaşayan yoksul bir mahallede bir apartman alıp kiracıları çıkarıp kendine lüks ev yapmak ister, ama oradaki sakinlere ısınır.

out.en_query: A spoiled rich young man buys an apartment building in a poor gentrifying neighborhood to evict tenants for a luxury home but grows attached to the residents.
out.hyde: An affluent and spoiled young man relies on his wealthy family's allowance while seeking a passion project. He purchases a run-down apartment building in a impoverished neighborhood undergoing gentrification, planning to evict the current tenants and convert the property into a lavish personal residence. However, after moving in to oversee the process, he begins spending time with the quirky and resilient residents. As he experiences their tight-knit community and struggles firsthand, his perspective shifts, leading him to rethink his eviction plans and take a stand against further redevelopment of the area.

tr: Çocuksu ve içine kapanık genç bir kız, dul babası ve bakıcıyla Fransa'nın kıyısındaki eski bir evde yalnız yaşar; bir hapishane otobüsü kazasından kaçan mahkûmlardan biri hayatlarına girer.

out.en_query: An introverted young girl living with her widowed father on the French coast has her life changed when an escaped prisoner from a bus crash enters their home.
out.hyde: Living in an isolated cliffside estate on the coast of France, an introverted young woman resides with her widowed father and a devoted caretaker. Her quiet and sheltered life is upended when a prison transport bus crashes on a nearby highway, allowing several convicts to escape into the countryside. One of the fleeing prisoners sneaks into the family's remote home to hide from the authorities. Instead of raising the alarm, the young woman develops a complex connection with the intruder, destabilizing the fragile dynamic inside the household.

tr: Manhattan'da lüks içinde yaşayan zengin bir sanayici, toplama kampından sağ kurtulduğunu söyler; bir gün İsrailli ajanlar onu kaçırıp savaş suçlarından yargılamak üzere götürür.

out.en_query: A wealthy Manhattan industrialist claiming to be a concentration camp survivor is kidnapped by Israeli agents to stand trial for Nazi war crimes.
out.hyde: Arthur Goldman lives in a luxurious Manhattan penthouse, posing as a wealthy Jewish industrialist and survivor of Nazi concentration camps. Despite his erratic behavior and obsession with the Holocaust, he maintains a prominent social status. Secret agents working for Israel track Goldman down, abduct him from his home, and transport him to Israel. Once there, he is placed inside a bulletproof glass booth to stand trial as a former SS officer accused of horrific war crimes.

titles.title: The Man in the Glass Booth

tr: Nazi Almanya'sından kaçan Yahudi bir doktor, İngiltere'de omurilik yaralanması geçirmiş askerlerin umutsuzca yattığı bir hastanede yeni rehabilitasyon yöntemleri uygular ve sporu tedavi aracı yapar.

out.en_query: A Jewish doctor escaping Nazi Germany introduces sports rehabilitation for spinal injury soldiers in a British hospital.
out.hyde: Dr. Ludwig Guttmann, a Jewish neurologist who fled Nazi Germany, arrives at Stoke Mandeville Hospital in England during World War II. He is tasked with taking over the ward for paralyzed soldiers with severe spinal cord injuries, who are expected to die from complications. Rejecting the traditional passive bed-rest approach, Guttmann introduces groundbreaking rehabilitation techniques and insists on active patient movement. He introduces wheelchair sports, such as polo and archery, to restore physical endurance and self-respect to the injured veterans. Despite initial resistance from senior medical staff and hopeless patients, his methods dramatically improve survival rates and morale, leading to the birth of the Paralympic movement.

tr: Tüm tarihî kayıtların manyetik bir fırtınayla silindiği gelecekten üç zaman yolcusu, kurucu belgeleri geri getirmek için 1776 yılına gönderilir ama işler planlandığı gibi gitmez.

out.en_query: Three time travelers from a future with erased history travel back to 1776 to retrieve founding documents
out.hyde: In a dystopian future where an electromagnetic catastrophe has destroyed all recorded history, a team of three time travelers is assigned a critical mission. They are sent back to the year 1776 to retrieve the original founding documents of the nation before they are lost forever. However, upon arriving in revolutionary America, their equipment malfunctions and separates the team amidst the turmoil. As they attempt to carry out their objective, their interference threatens to alter the outcome of the American Revolution. The travelers must find each other and secure the documents without permanently fracturing the timeline.

tr: Kutup bölgesindeki bir araştırma üssünün yakınında, nükleer denizaltıya esrarengiz bir su altı varlığı saldırır ve onu elektromanyetik bir darbeyle etkisiz hâle getirir.

out.en_query: A mysterious underwater entity attacks a nuclear submarine with an electromagnetic pulse near a polar research base
out.hyde: Deep beneath the ice near an Arctic research station, a nuclear submarine suffers a catastrophic blackout after being hit by a massive electromagnetic shockwave. The crew soon discovers that the source is a gigantic, unknown aquatic organism dwelling in the polar ocean abyss. Trapped on the ocean floor without power or communication, the survivors must conserve their fading oxygen while defending the vessel against the creature's aggressive probes. Meanwhile, scientists at the nearby surface base attempt a risky deep-sea dive to salvage the sub, unaware that the entity is attracted to their electronic equipment.

tr: Arazisini ve evini kaybetmek zorunda kalan huysuz yaşlı bir Teksas çiftçisi, karavan parkına gitmek yerine torunuyla birlikte Meksika'ya yola çıkar ve yolda iki otostopçu alırlar.

out.en_query: A grumpy old Texas rancher forced off his land travels to Mexico with his grandson instead of moving into a trailer park.
out.hyde: Facing the loss of his Texas ranch, an elderly and stubborn farmer refuses to spend his remaining years in a trailer park. Instead, he packs up his belongings and decides to head across the border into Mexico for one final adventure, bringing along his estranged grandson. Along the way, the unlikely pair pick up two hitchhikers, triggering a series of dangerous encounters and comedic misadventures. As they travel further south, the journey helps bridge the generational divide between the old man and his grandson.

tr: Sevgilisi tarafından terk edilen sıradan bir ofis çalışanı, hiç oyunculuk tecrübesi olmadığı halde yerel amatör tiyatronun bir klasik oyunundaki başrol için seçmelere girer ve rolü kapar.

out.en_query: An ordinary office worker dumped by their partner auditions for and wins the lead role in a local amateur theater production of a classic play despite having no acting experience.
out.hyde: Following a sudden and painful breakup with his longtime partner, Arthur, a quiet office accountant, decides to break his mundane routine. Spotting a poster for a local community theater's upcoming production of a classic play, he impulsively decides to audition despite having no prior acting background. Impressed by his raw, unpolished vulnerability during the read-through, the eccentric director unexpectedly awards him the lead role. As rehearsals get underway, Arthur struggles with severe stage fright, memorizing dialogue, and fitting in with the colorful cast of amateur actors. Through the therapeutic process of performing and the support of his new theater peers, he gradually learns to channel his grief into his character and rebuild his self-confidence.

tr: Dominik Cumhuriyeti'ndeki bir beyzbol akademisinde yetişen, köyünde yıldız gibi görülen genç bir oyuncu, profesyonel olma hayaliyle yola çıkar.

out.en_query: a young baseball player from the Dominican Republic leaves his village to pursue a professional career at a baseball academy
out.hyde: Miguel Santos, a talented 18-year-old pitcher from a small town in the Dominican Republic, is signed by a major league baseball academy. He travels to the United States to compete against other hopefuls for a spot in the professional leagues. As he navigates the cultural barriers and the intense pressure of the scouting system, Miguel struggles to adapt to his new environment. He faces personal challenges and the harsh reality of the business side of sports. Ultimately, he must decide what he is willing to sacrifice to achieve his dream of playing in the big leagues.

tr: Üç profesyonel kaçıkçı, iki genç kızı korkunç bir mafya babasına teslim etmek için yola çıkmışken kaybolur ve doğaüstü bir tehlikenin içine düşer.

out.en_query: Three professional smugglers get lost while transporting two young girls to a dangerous mob boss and encounter supernatural threats.
out.hyde: Three hardened smugglers are tasked with transporting two young women across a desolate border region to deliver them to a ruthless crime lord. As they navigate the treacherous terrain, their vehicle breaks down in a remote, fog-shrouded forest. Tensions rise between the smugglers and their captives as they realize they are being hunted by an ancient, malevolent entity that feeds on fear. One by one, the group members are picked off by the supernatural force, forcing the survivors to form an uneasy alliance. Ultimately, they must confront the entity in a desperate bid for survival before they are consumed by the darkness.

tr: Bir yüksek lisans öğrencisi, beş üniversite öğrencisi ekibini bütün geceye yayılan dev bir şehir oyununa davet eder ve takımlar birbirleriyle çekişerek yarışır.

out.en_query: A graduate student invites five teams of college students to compete in an all-night giant citywide scavenger hunt game.
out.hyde: A graduate student named Leon devises an elaborate, all-night puzzle game across the city and invites five teams of college students to compete. The teams, representing different campus archetypes and dressed in matching colors, race against each other to solve cryptic clues placed at various urban landmarks. Throughout the night, the competitors face unexpected hurdles, interpersonal conflicts, and humorous attempts at sabotage from rival groups. As dawn approaches, the exhausted teams converge on the final location in a frantic dash to claim ultimate victory.

tr: Varlıklı ailesinden ve parasından vazgeçen genç bir adam, ülkeyi boydan boya dolaşıp sonunda kuzeydeki ıssız vahşi doğada doğayla başbaşa yaşamaya çalışır.

out.en_query: a young man leaves his wealthy family and money to travel across the country and live in the Alaskan wilderness
out.hyde: Christopher McCandless, a top student and athlete, decides to abandon his conventional life after graduating from college. He donates his savings to charity, discards his identification, and sets out on a journey across the United States under the name Alexander Supertramp. His travels lead him through various landscapes, meeting colorful characters who influence his philosophy on life. Eventually, he makes his way to the remote Alaskan wilderness, seeking a life of solitude and connection with nature. Living in an abandoned bus, he struggles to survive the harsh environment as he faces the ultimate test of his ideals.

tr: Güney Amerika'da büyük bir şehrin yoksul bir mahallesinde büyüyen iki çocuktan biri fotoğrafçı olmayı hayal ederken diğeri uyuşturucu çetelerinin acımasız lideri olur; mahalle yirmi yıl boyunca şiddetin içine gömülür.

out.en_query: two childhood friends in a South American slum take diverging paths as one becomes a photographer and the other a ruthless drug lord over two decades
out.hyde: In the sprawling, impoverished favelas of Rio de Janeiro, two young boys named Rocket and Li'l Zé grow up in the shadow of systemic violence. While Rocket dreams of escaping the cycle of poverty through his passion for photography, Li'l Zé embraces the criminal underworld, rising to become a feared and ruthless drug kingpin. Over the course of two decades, their paths diverge as the neighborhood descends into a brutal turf war. Rocket documents the escalating chaos and the tragic toll the conflict takes on the innocent residents trapped in the crossfire. Ultimately, Rocket must decide whether to risk his life to expose the truth or remain a silent observer of the destruction surrounding him.

tr: Noel öncesi Londra'da birbirine bağlanan pek çok kişinin farklı aşk hikâyeleri; başbakandan şarkıcıya, evli çiftlerden platonik âşıklara kadar herkes sevgiyi arar.

out.en_query: interconnected love stories in London during the Christmas season
out.hyde: In the weeks leading up to Christmas in London, the lives of several disparate individuals become intertwined through their search for love. The newly elected Prime Minister finds himself falling for a junior staffer at 10 Downing Street, while a grieving widower helps his young stepson navigate his first crush. A fading rock star attempts a comeback with a festive song, and a woman struggles to balance her professional life with the care of her mentally ill brother. As the holiday approaches, these characters experience the highs and lows of romance, ultimately discovering that love is present in many forms throughout the city.

tr: Dünyanın dört ayrı ucunda, birbiriyle ilgisiz görünen insanların hayatları, tek bir tüfek atışıyla ve iletişimsizlikle trajik biçimde birbirine bağlanır.

out.en_query: a film about interconnected lives across different continents linked by a single gunshot and miscommunication
out.hyde: The narrative follows four disparate stories unfolding in Morocco, Mexico, Japan, and the United States. A tragic accident involving a stray bullet fired by two young boys in the Moroccan desert sets off a chain reaction that ripples across the globe. In the United States, a grieving couple struggles to cope with the aftermath of the shooting, while their Mexican nanny faces a desperate situation while traveling across the border. Meanwhile, in Tokyo, a deaf-mute teenager grapples with isolation and her own complex family dynamics. As these seemingly unrelated lives collide, the film explores the profound consequences of cultural misunderstanding and the fragility of human connection.

tr: Dünyaya doğru yaklaşan dev bir gezegen yüzünden dünyanın sonu yaklaşırken, depresyondaki bir kadın ve kız kardeşi bu sondan çok farklı şekillerde etkilenir.

out.en_query: a depressed woman and her sister deal with the impending apocalypse caused by a rogue planet approaching Earth
out.hyde: Justine is a young woman struggling with severe depression who is preparing for her wedding at her sister Claire's luxurious estate. As the festivities unfold, a rogue planet named Melancholia emerges from behind the sun, threatening to collide with Earth. While Claire becomes increasingly frantic and terrified about the impending destruction of the world, Justine finds a strange sense of calm and acceptance. The sisters navigate their strained relationship and differing psychological states as the planet draws closer. In the final moments, they sit together in a makeshift shelter, waiting for the inevitable impact that will extinguish all life.

tr: Sıradan insanların öfke ve intikam duygusuna yenik düşüp kontrolden çıktığı, birbirinden bağımsız altı kara komedi hikâyesi.

out.en_query: anthology film featuring six independent dark comedy stories about ordinary people losing control due to anger and revenge
out.hyde: The film consists of six standalone segments, each exploring the thin line between civilization and savagery. In one story, a man seeks vengeance against those who wronged him during a flight. Another segment follows a road rage incident between two drivers that escalates into a lethal confrontation. A third tale depicts a man who reaches his breaking point with a towing company, leading to a destructive rampage. Throughout the film, ordinary individuals are pushed to their limits by bureaucracy, betrayal, and personal slights. As their frustrations boil over, they abandon social norms to exact brutal revenge, resulting in chaotic and darkly humorous consequences.

tr: Uçağı yüksek bir dağ silsilesine düşen bir ragbi takımı ve yakınları, donarak ölme tehlikesiyle haftalarca mahsur kalır ve hayatta kalmak için çok ağır bir karar vermek zorunda kalır.

out.en_query: a rugby team survives a plane crash in the Andes mountains and resorts to cannibalism to stay alive
out.hyde: In 1972, a Uruguayan rugby team is traveling to Chile when their plane crashes into a remote, snow-covered peak in the Andes mountains. With no hope of immediate rescue, the survivors face sub-zero temperatures and dwindling food supplies. As the days turn into weeks, they realize that the only way to avoid starvation is to consume the bodies of their deceased friends and family members. This harrowing decision sparks a deep moral and psychological struggle among the group. Eventually, two of the survivors embark on a perilous trek across the mountains to find help and bring the others home.

tr: Yılbaşı gecesi bir otelde çalışan hizmetçi çocuğun yaşadığı, dört farklı odada geçen, dört yönetmenin çektiği ucu açık komik ve tuhaf hikâyeler.

out.en_query: anthology film featuring four interconnected stories set in a hotel on New Year's Eve directed by four different directors
out.hyde: On New Year's Eve, a bellhop named Ted begins his first night at the historic Mon Signor Hotel. As he navigates the eccentric guests across four different rooms, he finds himself entangled in increasingly bizarre situations. In one room, a coven of witches attempts to resurrect their goddess, while in another, a jealous husband threatens his wife with a gun. A third room features a couple of unruly children left alone by their parents, and the final room involves a high-stakes bet between a filmmaker and his friends. Ted struggles to maintain his composure as the night descends into chaotic, dark comedy.

tr: Bir ülkede yayımlanan yabancı bir dergi, editörün ölümü üzerine son sayısını hazırlar; üç haber hikâyesi ve bir veda yazısı, şehrin görsel olarak abartılı bir portresini çizer.

out.en_query: A film about a foreign magazine published in a city, featuring three news stories and an obituary following the editor's death, presented with a visually stylized aesthetic.

out.hyde: In a small, dusty village in Iran, a young boy named Ahmad accidentally takes his classmate's notebook home after school. Knowing that his friend will be expelled if he does not return the homework, Ahmad embarks on a perilous journey to the neighboring village. He navigates the labyrinthine alleys and encounters various indifferent adults who offer little help in his quest. Despite the overwhelming odds and the setting sun, his persistence reflects the innocence and moral clarity of childhood. Ultimately, he manages to return the notebook just in time, preserving his friend's future in a quiet, poignant victory.
